l-e-e3-b01-01.title: A na-eji mkpụrụedemede ukwu naanị n'mmalite ahịrị okwu?
l-e-e3-b01-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "In English sentences, a capital letter is used only for the first letter" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e3-b01-01.material: Nkwupụta: N'ahịrị okwu Bekee, a na-eji mkpụrụedemede ukwu naanị maka mkpụrụedemede mbụ. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e3-b01-01.s.s1.r.a: Naanị B mbụ bụ mkpụrụedemede ukwu. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-01.s.s1.r.b: Naanị D mbụ bụ mkpụrụedemede ukwu. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-01.s.s1.r.c: Naanị W mbụ bụ mkpụrụedemede ukwu. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-01.s.s1.explain: I na Sam dị n'etiti ahịrị okwu bụkwa mkpụrụedemede ukwu. Dee I (mụ) na aha site n'mkpụrụedemede ukwu ebe ọ bụla ha dị.
l-e-e3-b01-01.s.s2.model.0: Today I meet Sam. nwere I na Sam n'etiti, ma ha bụ mkpụrụedemede ukwu, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.
l-e-e3-b01-01.s.s2.model.1: A na-ede aha Sam site n'mkpụrụedemede ukwu ọbụna n'etiti ahịrị okwu, ya mere ikwu na mkpụrụedemede ukwu na-aga naanị n'mmalite adịghị mma.

l-e-e3-b01-02.title: Ọ bụrụ na okwu na-amalite site n'otu mkpụrụedemede, ụda mbụ ọ bụ otu?
l-e-e3-b01-02.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "Words that start with the same letter have the same first sound" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e3-b01-02.material: Nkwupụta: If words start with the same letter, their first sound is the same. Chọta ụzọ okwu abụọ na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e3-b01-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ụzọ okwu abụọ na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-02.s.s1.r.a: Ha abụọ na-amalite site na /k/. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-02.s.s1.r.c: Ha abụọ na-amalite site na /s/. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-02.s.s1.r.d: Ha abụọ na-amalite site na /p/. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-02.s.s1.explain: C dị na city dị ka /s/. C dị na cat dị ka /k/, ya mere ụda mbụ dị iche.
l-e-e3-b01-02.s.s2.model.0: cat na-amalite site na /k/ ma city na-amalite site na /s/, ma ha abụọ na-amalite site na c, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.
l-e-e3-b01-02.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna na city na-amalite site na c, ọ dị ka /s/, ya mere otu mkpụrụedemede apụtaghị otu ụda mbụ.

l-e-e3-b01-03.title: Abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa bụ They mgbe niile?
l-e-e3-b01-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "The word that stands for two or more is always They" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e3-b01-03.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe mmadụ abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa dị, okwu na-anọchi ha bụ They mgbe niile. Chọta nnochi na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e3-b01-03.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nnochi na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e3-b01-03.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ mmadụ abụọ na-agụnyeghị m, ya mere They ziri ezi. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-03.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ mmadụ abụọ na-agụnyeghị m, ya mere They ziri ezi. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-03.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ mmadụ abụọ na-agụnyeghị m, ya mere They ziri ezi. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-03.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na agụnyere onye na-ekwu okwu (I), jiri We. They bụ maka ọtụtụ mmadụ na-agụnyeghị m.
l-e-e3-b01-03.s.s2.model.0: Sam and I gụnyere onye na-ekwu okwu, bụ m, ya mere jiri We, ọ bụghị They. Ya mere nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.
l-e-e3-b01-03.s.s2.model.1: Otu ìgwè gụnyere m bụ We, ya mere abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa abụghị They mgbe niile.

l-e-e3-b01-04.title: Oge gara aga na-were -ed mgbe niile?
l-e-e3-b01-04.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "To talk about the past, add -ed to the verb" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e3-b01-04.material: Nkwupụta: To talk about something done yesterday, just add -ed to the end of the verb. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e3-b01-04.s.s1.r.a: Agbakwunyere ed na play. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-04.s.s1.r.b: Agbakwunyere ed na walk. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-04.s.s1.r.d: Agbakwunyere ed na jump. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-04.s.s1.explain: Oge gara aga nke go bụ went, ọ bụghị goed. Ụfọdụ ngwaa na-enweghị usoro na-agbanwe ụdị ha.
l-e-e3-b01-04.s.s2.model.0: go na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ went, ọ bụghị goed, ya mere nkwupụta na ị nwere ike ịgbakwunye -ed naanị adịghị mma.
l-e-e3-b01-04.s.s2.model.1: went enweghị -ed ma ọ ka bụ oge gara aga, ya mere ọ na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-e3-b01-05.title: Mgbe He gasịrị, anyị na-agbakwunye naanị -s na ngwaa?
l-e-e3-b01-05.topic: Omume kwa ụbọchị na ikwu okwu
l-e-e3-b01-05.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "In He sentences, just add -s to the verb" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e3-b01-05.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe ị na-akọwa omume kwa ụbọchị site na He, gbakwunye -s n'ọgwụgwụ ngwaa naanị. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e3-b01-05.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-05.s.s1.r.a: Agbakwunyere naanị s na run. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-05.s.s1.r.b: Agbakwunyere naanị s na wake. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-05.s.s1.r.c: Agbakwunyere naanị s na eat. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b01-05.s.s1.explain: Ịgbakwunye -s na have na-eme haves, ma ụdị ziri ezi bụ has.
l-e-e3-b01-05.s.s2.model.0: have+s ga-abụ haves, ma ụdị ziri ezi bụ has, ya mere nkwupụta na ịgbakwunye -s zuru ezu adịghị mma.
l-e-e3-b01-05.s.s2.model.1: has abụghị ụdị e gbakwunyere naanị -s, ya mere ahịrị okwu a bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-e-e3-b02-02.title: Mkpụrụedemede a ọ̀ na-akpụ otu ụda mgbe niile?
l-e-e3-b02-02.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “The letter a in a word always makes the short a sound” bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa.
l-e-e3-b02-02.material: Nkwupụta: The letter a in a word always makes the short a sound, like the a in cat. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e3-b02-02.s.s1.r.a: A dị mkpụmkpụ, dị ka n'cat. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b02-02.s.s1.r.b: A dị mkpụmkpụ, dị ka n'cat. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b02-02.s.s1.r.c: A dị mkpụmkpụ, dị ka n'cat. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b02-02.s.s1.explain: A dị n'cake dị ogologo, dị ka aha mkpụrụedemede (“ay”). Ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.
l-e-e3-b02-02.s.s2.model.0: N'adịghị ka a dị n'cat, a dị n'cake na-ada dị ka “ay”, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.

l-e-e3-b02-04.topic: Ogologo nke ụdị oge gara aga
l-e-e3-b02-04.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “The past form always has more letters than the present form” bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa.
l-e-e3-b02-04.material: Nkwupụta: The past form always has more letters than the present form. Chọta ụzọ (oge ugbu a - oge gara aga) na-emegide nkwupụta a.

l-e-e3-b02-04.s.s1.explain: Ụdị oge gara aga nke cut bụkwa cut. Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede anaghị abawanye.

l-e-e3-b02-04.s.s2.model.1: Ụdị oge gara aga nke cut bụ otu ihe ahụ dị ka ụdị oge ugbu a ma ọ dịghị ogologo karịa, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-e-e3-b02-05.title: Ọ̀ bụ a ma ọ bụ an mgbe niile mgbe eat?
l-e-e3-b02-05.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “You must put a or an before the word after I eat” bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa.
l-e-e3-b02-05.material: Nkwupụta: Before the food word that comes after I eat, you always put a or an. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e3-b02-05.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-eji an, dị ka n'an apple. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b02-05.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-eji an, dị ka n'an egg. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b02-05.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-eji a, dị ka n'a banana. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b02-05.s.s1.explain: Ị naghị etinye a tupu aha nri breakfast. A na-ede aha nri dịka ha dị.
l-e-e3-b02-05.s.s2.model.0: I eat breakfast. enweghị a ma ọ bụ an tupu breakfast mana ọ ka bụ ahịrịokwu ziri ezi, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.
l-e-e3-b02-05.s.s2.model.1: A na-ede aha nri na-enweghị a ma ọ bụ an, ya mere ikwu na a na-agbakwunye ha mgbe niile ezighi ezi.

l-e-e3-b03-01.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta 'The first sound of a letter's name is the same as the sound the letter makes' bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e3-b03-01.material: Nkwupụta: The first sound of an alphabet letter's name is the same as the sound the letter makes. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, aha B, bee, na-amalite site na /b/, ma ụda B bụkwa /b/. Chọta mkpụrụedemede na-adabaghị.
l-e-e3-b03-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ mkpụrụedemede na-adabaghị na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b03-01.s.s1.r.a: Aha na ụda abụọ bụ /k/. Ihe atụ a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b03-01.s.s1.r.b: Aha na ụda abụọ bụ /d/. Ihe atụ a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b03-01.s.s1.r.d: Aha na ụda abụọ bụ /b/. Ihe atụ a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b03-01.s.s1.explain: Aha W, double-u, na-amalite site na /d/, ma ụda W na-eme bụ /w/. Ya mere nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.
l-e-e3-b03-01.s.s2.model.0: Aha W na-amalite site na /d/ ma ụda W bụ /w/, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.
l-e-e3-b03-01.s.s2.model.1: B, D, na K nwere otu aha na ụda, ma W dị iche, ya mere W bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-e-e3-b03-02.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta 'The e at the end of a word is not pronounced' bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e3-b03-02.material: Nkwupụta: The e at the end of a word is not pronounced. N'cake, a naghị ekwu e. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.

l-e-e3-b04-01.goal: Chee echiche ma nkwupụta “b, d na h bụ naanị obere mkpụrụedemede toro ogologo” ọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ ebe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere ya).

l-e-e3-b06-02.s.s1.r.a: Ụda mbụ bụ “chi”. Ọ bụ ihe atụ na-akwado nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e3-b06-02.s.s1.r.b: Ụda mbụ bụ “chi”. Ọ bụ ihe atụ na-akwado nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-e3-b04-10.title: Ịkwekọrịta okwu ajụjụ na ihe ha na-ajụ
l-e-e3-b04-10.topic: Okwu ajụjụ na ihe ha na-ajụ
l-e-e3-b04-10.goal: Iji chọta nkwekọrịta dị n'etiti okwu ajụjụ na ihe ha na-ajụ, chọpụta kedu ụkpụrụ (ozi) achọrọ n'ezie, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-e3-b04-10.material: Okwu ajụjụ na-ajụ ihe dị iche iche. Who na-ajụ banyere onye, Where na-ajụ banyere ebe, When na-ajụ banyere oge, ma What na-ajụ banyere ihe ma ọ bụ ihe omume. Chọta nkwekọrịta ziri ezi.

l-e-e3-b04-10.s.s1.r.a: What na-ajụ banyere ihe ma ọ bụ ihe omume, ọ bụghị oge.
l-e-e3-b04-10.s.s1.r.c: When na-ajụ banyere oge, ọ bụghị ebe.
l-e-e3-b04-10.s.s1.r.d: Where na-ajụ banyere ebe, ọ bụghị onye.
l-e-e3-b04-10.s.s1.explain: Who na-ajụ banyere onye. Ndị ọzọ bụ Where = ebe, When = oge, na What = ihe ma ọ bụ ihe omume.

l-e-e3-b04-10.s.s2.model.1: Nkwekọrịta ndị ọzọ dị iche n'ihe Where, When, na What na-ajụ, ya mere Who - onye ziri ezi.

l-e-e3-b01-12.s.s2.model.1: Dị ka “the books”, ihe abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa bụ They; ya mere ọtụtụ nnụnụ bụkwa They.

l-e-e3-b01-14.title: Iwu maka ịhọrọ am, is, ma ọ bụ are
l-e-e3-b01-14.topic: Omume kwa ụbọchị na ikwu okwu
l-e-e3-b01-14.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ngwaa be am, is, are, kwuo iwu ị chọpụtara ma nwalee ya n’ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-e3-b01-14.material: I am happy. He is happy. She is happy. They are happy. You are happy. Chọta iwu ahụ ma mezue We ___ happy.
l-e-e3-b01-14.s.s1.r.b: A na-eji am naanị na I. Ọ dabaghị na We.
l-e-e3-b01-14.s.s1.r.c: A naghị eji be naanị ya n’ahịrịokwu a.
l-e-e3-b01-14.s.s1.r.d: A na-eji is maka otu onye (He, She). We karịrị otu.
l-e-e3-b01-14.s.s1.explain: I na-eji am, He na She na-eji is, ebe ọtụtụ mmadụ They na-eji are. We bụkwa ọtụtụ, ya mere were are.
l-e-e3-b01-14.s.s2.model.0: A na-eji are na ọtụtụ mmadụ dịka You na They, ya mere We na-ejikwa are.
l-e-e3-b01-14.s.s2.model.1: am na-aga na I, is na-aga na otu onye, ya mere We nke bụ ọtụtụ chọrọ are.

l-e-e3-b02-18.material: N'egwuregwu ụda mbụ, ekwuru ụda mbụ nke okwu 10 n'sekọnd 30. Tụọ ihe dị ka ole a pụrụ ikwu n'nkeji 2 n'otu ọsọ.
l-e-e3-b02-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ okwu bụ nke kwesịrị ekwesị?
l-e-e3-b02-18.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ nkeji 2, ya mere ị mụbara naanị site na 2. Nkeji 2 bụ ugboro 4 nke sekọnd 30.
l-e-e3-b02-18.s.s1.r.b: Ị were ọnụọgụ sekọnd 30 dị ka ọ dị.
l-e-e3-b02-18.s.s1.r.d: Ị were ya dị ka ugboro 6, ọ bụghị 4, nke bụ sekọnd 120 kewara site na sekọnd 30.
l-e-e3-b02-18.s.s1.explain: Nkeji 2 bụ sekọnd 30 ugboro 4. Okwu 10, ugboro 4, bụ ihe dị ka okwu 40.

l-e-e3-b02-20.goal: Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ahịrịokwu ị nwere ike iji kaadị okwu mee, kpebie oke kwesịrị ekwesị ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e3-b02-20.material: Kaadị okwu dị 31. A chọrọ ihe dị ka kaadị 5 iji mee otu ahịrịokwu. Tụọ ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu ole a ga-eme.
l-e-e3-b02-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụ ọgụgụ ahịrịokwu nwere ezi uche?

l-e-e3-b02-20.s.s1.r.d: Ọ dị ka iji naanị ọkara kaadị 31 ahụ. Ị nwere ike iji kaadị karịa.

l-e-e3-b02-20.s.s2.model.0: Ị were 31 dị ka 30 wee kee ya na 5, nke na-enye 6; ya mere a pụrụ ime ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 6.

l-e-e3-b03-17.topic: Oge a na-ewe ịga ụlọ akwụkwọ na ịlọta n'otu izu
l-e-e3-b03-17.goal: Tụ anya oge a na-ewe ịga ụlọ akwụkwọ na ịlọta n'otu izu iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-e3-b03-17.material: Ịga ụlọ akwụkwọ na ịlọta na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 25 n'ụbọchị. Ị na-aga ụlọ akwụkwọ ụbọchị 5 n'otu izu. Tụ anya ihe dị ka oge ole ị na-eji ịga na ịbịa n'otu izu.
l-e-e3-b03-17.s.s1.r.a: Ọ gbakọrọ naanị ụbọchị 2 ma ọ bụ 3, ọ bụghị ụbọchị 5.
l-e-e3-b03-17.s.s1.r.c: O mere ka ụbọchị ghọọ okpukpu abụọ ruo nkeji 50.
l-e-e3-b03-17.s.s1.explain: Nkeji 25 dị nso n'nkeji 30. Nkeji 30 maka ụbọchị 5 bụ nkeji 150, gburugburu awa 2 nkeji 30, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka awa 2.
l-e-e3-b03-17.s.s2.model.0: Nkeji 25 n'ụbọchị bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 30, ya mere ụbọchị 5 na-abịaru nkeji 150, nke bụ ihe dị ka awa 2.
l-e-e3-b03-17.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbakwunye nkeji 25 ugboro 5 na-enye nkeji 125, ya mere ọ bụ gburugburu awa 2.

l-e-e3-b04-16.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ dị n'ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ anọ iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e3-b04-16.material: Ọbá akwụkwọ klaasị nwere ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ nwere ebe anọ. Ihe dị ka akwụkwọ 25 dị n'ebe ọ bụla. Tụọ atụmatụ ihe dị ka akwụkwọ ole dị n'ozuzu.
l-e-e3-b04-16.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị nso n'ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ dị n'otu ebe. Ọ mịkọrịtaghị site n'ebe anọ.
l-e-e3-b04-16.s.s1.r.c: Ọ were otu ebe dị ka ihe dị ka akwụkwọ 75, nke buru ibu nke ukwuu.
l-e-e3-b04-16.s.s1.r.d: Ọ were otu ebe dị ka ihe dị ka akwụkwọ 250, nke buru ibu nke ukwuu.

l-e-e3-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbakwunye 25, ugboro 4, na-enye 100, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka akwụkwọ 100.

l-e-e3-b04-18.title: Oge maka klaasị niile ikwu mkpụrụ ụda mbụ ha
l-e-e3-b04-18.topic: Klaasị niile na-ekwu mkpụrụ ụda mbụ
l-e-e3-b04-18.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ oge maka ụmụ akwụkwọ niile n'klaasị ikwu otu mkpụrụ ụda mbụ, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e3-b04-18.material: Klaasị anyị nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ 28. Ọ na-ewe otu nwa akwụkwọ ihe dị ka sekọnd 3 ikwu mkpụrụ ụda mbụ nke okwu. Tụọ atụmatụ ogologo oge ọ ga-ewe ma onye ọ bụla kwuo otu ugboro.
l-e-e3-b04-18.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ oge maka naanị ihe dị ka ụmụ akwụkwọ 10 ikwu okwu.
l-e-e3-b04-18.s.s1.r.c: Ọ were otu nwa akwụkwọ dị ka ịnara oge karịa sekọnd 10.
l-e-e3-b04-18.s.s1.r.d: Ọ were otu nwa akwụkwọ dị ka ịnara oge karịa sekọnd 20.
l-e-e3-b04-18.s.s1.explain: 28 dị nso na 30. Na sekọnd 3 nke ọ bụla, ụmụ akwụkwọ 30 na-ewe sekọnd 90, nke bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 1 sekọnd 30.
l-e-e3-b04-18.s.s2.model.0: Iwere 28 dị ka 30, sekọnd 3 nke ọ bụla bụ sekọnd 90, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 1 sekọnd 30.
l-e-e3-b04-18.s.s2.model.1: Sekọnd 3 ugboro 28 bụ ihe dị ka sekọnd 84, ya mere ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 1 sekọnd 30.

l-e-e3-b04-19.title: Ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu e mere n'nkeji 25
l-e-e3-b04-19.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu enwere ike ime n'nkeji 25 iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e3-b04-19.material: Ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 2 ime otu ahịrịokwu site na kaadị okwu. Tụọ atụmatụ ihe dị ka ole ị nwere ike ime n'nkeji 25 n'otu ọsọ ahụ.
l-e-e3-b04-19.s.s1.r.a: Ọ were otu ahịrịokwu dị ka ịnara ihe dị ka nkeji 5.
l-e-e3-b04-19.s.s1.r.c: Ọ were otu ahịrịokwu dị ka ịnara nkeji 1.
l-e-e3-b04-19.s.s1.r.d: Ọ mịkọrịtara nkeji 25 site na 2. Ị ghaghị ikewa.
l-e-e3-b04-19.s.s1.explain: Otu ahịrịokwu kwa nkeji 2, ya mere nkeji 25 na-ejide ihe dị ka ìgwè 12 nke nkeji 2. Ọ bụ ihe dị ka 12.
l-e-e3-b04-19.s.s2.model.0: Ihe dị ka ìgwè 12 nke nkeji 2 na-abanye n'nkeji 25, ya mere ị nwere ike ime ihe dị ka 12.
l-e-e3-b04-19.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ nkeji 2 maka ahịrịokwu ọ bụla, ya mere ikewa nkeji 25 site na 2 na-enye ihe dị ka 12.

l-e-e3-b04-20.title: Ngwaa ole na-agbanwe udi ha?
l-e-e3-b04-20.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ngwaa na-agbanwe udi iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e3-b04-20.material: E nwere ndepụta nke ngwaa 50. Ihe dị ka 1 n'ime 5 ọ bụla na-agbanwe udi ya n'oge gara aga, dịka went. Tụọ atụmatụ ihe dị ka ngwaa ole na-agbanwe udi.
l-e-e3-b04-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ ngwaa na-agbanwe udi kwesịrị ekwesị?
l-e-e3-b04-20.s.s1.r.a: Ọ were 5 site na "1 n'ime 5" dị ka o dị.
l-e-e3-b04-20.s.s1.r.c: Ọ were ya dị ka 1 n'ime 4 ọ bụla.
l-e-e3-b04-20.s.s1.r.d: Ọ were ya dị ka 4 n'ime 5 ọ bụla.
l-e-e3-b04-20.s.s1.explain: 1 n'ime 5 bụ 1/5. 1/5 nke 50 bụ 10, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 10.
l-e-e3-b04-20.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ 1/5 nke 50, ya mere ihe dị ka 10 na-agbanwe udi.
l-e-e3-b04-20.s.s2.model.1: 1 na-agbanwe n'ime 5 ọ bụla, ya mere ọ bụrụ na e nwere ìgwè 10 nke 5, ọ bụ ihe dị ka 10.

l-e-e3-b05-16.title: Oge ịgụ akụkọ anọ
l-e-e3-b05-16.goal: Tụọ oge ọ na-ewe ịgụ akụkọ anọ niile, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-e3-b05-16.material: Ịchọrọ ịgụ akụkọ 4. Ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 5 ịgụ otu. Tụọ oge ọ na-ewe ịgụ ha niile.
l-e-e3-b05-16.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ zuru ezu maka akụkọ abụọ. Akụkọ anọ na-ewe ogologo oge.
l-e-e3-b05-16.s.s1.r.c: Ọ were otu akụkọ dị ka nkeji 10. Ọ bụ nkeji 5.
l-e-e3-b05-16.s.s1.r.d: Ọ were otu akụkọ dị ka nkeji 15. Ọ bụ nkeji 5.
l-e-e3-b05-16.s.s1.explain: Na nkeji 5 maka akụkọ 4 nke ọ bụla, ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 = nkeji 20.
l-e-e3-b05-16.s.s2.model.0: Otu akụkọ bụ nkeji 5 ma e nwere akụkọ anọ, ya mere ihe dị ka nkeji 20, na-agbakwunye nkeji 5 ugboro anọ, kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-e3-b05-16.s.s2.model.1: Nkeji 5 ugboro anọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 20. Nkeji 10 zuru ezu maka akụkọ abụọ ma nkeji 40 dị ogologo nke ukwuu.

l-e-e3-b05-17.title: Oge iji ghara ịbịa ọ gafere oge maka klas ịwụ mmiri
l-e-e3-b05-17.goal: Tụọ oge ịmalite ịkwado maka klas ịwụ mmiri, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-e3-b05-17.material: Klas ịwụ mmiri na-amalite n'3:30. Ịkwado akpa na-ewe nkeji 10 ma ịga ebe ahụ na-ewe nkeji 25. Tụọ oge ịmalite ịkwado ka ịghara ịbịa ọ gafere oge.
l-e-e3-b05-17.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oge kacha ngwụsị ị ga-amalite ịkwado?
l-e-e3-b05-17.s.s1.r.b: Ị na-eru nkeji 35 mgbe ahụ, n'3:40. Nke ahụ bụ ịbịa ọ gafere oge.
l-e-e3-b05-17.s.s1.r.c: Ị na-eru nkeji 35 mgbe ahụ, n'3:50. Nke ahụ bụ ịbịa ọ gafere oge.
l-e-e3-b05-17.s.s1.r.d: Ị na-eru nkeji 35 mgbe ahụ, n'4:05. Nke ahụ bụ ịbịa ọ gafere oge.
l-e-e3-b05-17.s.s1.explain: Nkeji 10 tinye nkeji 25 bụ nkeji 35. Ị ga-amalitere n'2:55, nke bụ nkeji 35 tupu 3:30.
l-e-e3-b05-17.s.s2.model.0: Ịkwado na ịruo ebe ahụ na-ewe nkeji 35 n'ozuzu, ya mere ị ga-amalitere n'2:55, nke bụ nkeji 35 tupu 3:30.
l-e-e3-b05-17.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ị malite n'3:05, ị na-eru n'3:40 ma bịa n'oge gara aga, ya mere 2:55 ziri ezi.

l-e-e3-b05-18.title: Ọnụọgụ gburugburu egwuregwu ị ga-egwu na kaadị ụda mbụ
l-e-e3-b05-18.goal: Tụọ ọnụọgụ gburugburu egwuregwu na-eji kaadị ụda mbụ niile, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-e3-b05-18.material: E nwere kaadị ụda mbụ 30. Gburugburu ọ bụla na-eji kaadị 8. Tụọ gburugburu ole ị ga-egwurịrị iji jiri kaadị niile.
l-e-e3-b05-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ gburugburu kwesịrị ekwesị achọrọ?
l-e-e3-b05-18.s.s1.r.a: Na gburugburu 2, naanị kaadị 16 ka e ji. Nke ahụ erughị kaadị 30.
l-e-e3-b05-18.s.s1.r.c: Na gburugburu 8, a chọrọ kaadị 64. Nke ahụ dị ukwuu nke ukwuu.

l-e-e3-b06-19.goal: Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ ngwaa oge gara aga a mụtara n'otu ọnwa, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e3-b06-19.material: Ị na-amụta ngwaa oge gara aga 4 kwa ụbọchị. Tụọ anya ihe dị ka ole ụdị oge gara aga ị na-amụta n'ozuzu n'ime otu ọnwa (ụbọchị 30).
l-e-e3-b06-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ kwesịrị ekwesị a ga-amụta?
l-e-e3-b06-19.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ maka ụbọchị 3. Ọ bụghị otu ọnwa.
l-e-e3-b06-19.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ maka ụbọchị iri. Ọ bụghị otu ọnwa.
l-e-e3-b06-19.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ maka ụbọchị 100. Ọ dị ukwuu nke ukwuu.
l-e-e3-b06-19.s.s1.explain: 4 kwa ụbọchị maka ụbọchị 30 bụ 4 × 30 = ihe dị ka 120.
l-e-e3-b06-19.s.s2.model.0: 4 kwa ụbọchị maka ụbọchị 30 na-enye 4 × 30 = 120, ya mere ihe dị ka 120 ziri ezi.
l-e-e3-b06-19.s.s2.model.1: Ụbọchị 10 na-eme 40, ma otu ọnwa bụ ugboro atọ nke ahụ, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 120.

l-e-e3-b06-20.title: Ọnụọgụ e mere n'asọmpi ime ahịrị okwu
l-e-e3-b06-20.goal: Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ ahịrị okwu niile e mere n'asọmpi ime ahịrị okwu, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e3-b06-20.material: N'asọmpi ime ahịrị okwu, otu onye na-eme ahịrị okwu 3 n'nkeji 1. Mmadụ 4 na-eme ya nkeji 5. Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ ahịrị okwu niile e mere.
l-e-e3-b06-20.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ mmadụ 4 na-eme n'nkeji 1. Ọ bụghị nkeji 5.
l-e-e3-b06-20.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ maka nkeji 2 na sekọnd 30. Ọ bụghị nkeji 5.
l-e-e3-b06-20.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ maka nkeji 10. Ọ bụghị nkeji 5.
l-e-e3-b06-20.s.s1.explain: Mmadụ 4 na-eme 3 × 4 = 12 n'nkeji 1. N'nkeji 5, nke ahụ bụ 12 × 5 = ihe dị ka 60.
l-e-e3-b06-20.s.s2.model.0: 12 n'nkeji 1 ọ bụla maka nkeji 5 na-enye 12 × 5 = 60, ya mere ihe dị ka 60 ziri ezi.
l-e-e3-b06-20.s.s2.model.1: Otu onye na-eme 15 n'nkeji 5, ya mere mmadụ 4 na-eme ihe dị ka 60.

l-e-e3-b07-07.title: Oge ọ na-ewe ime kaadị ọrụ kwa ụbọchị
l-e-e3-b07-07.goal: Tụ anya oge ọ na-ewe ime kaadị okwu ọrụ kwa ụbọchị 24, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe mere.
l-e-e3-b07-07.material: Ị na-eme kaadị okwu ọrụ kwa ụbọchị 4 n'ụbọchị maka ụbọchị 6. Ime otu kaadị na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 1 na sekọnd 50.
l-e-e3-b07-07.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke bụ atụmatụ kacha kwesị ekwesị nke ngụkọta oge?
l-e-e3-b07-07.s.s1.r.a: Ọ tụrụ anya naanị oge maka kaadị 4 e mere n'otu ụbọchị.
l-e-e3-b07-07.s.s1.r.b: Ọ tụrụ anya otu kaadị dị ka nkeji 1, na-ebelata ya.
l-e-e3-b07-07.s.s1.r.d: Ọ tụrụ anya otu kaadị dị ka ihe dị ka nkeji 4, nke buru oke ibu.
l-e-e3-b07-07.s.s1.explain: Nkeji 1 sekọnd 50 bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 2, ma 4×6=kaadị 24. 24×2 bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 48, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 45.
l-e-e3-b07-07.s.s2.model.0: Itụ anya otu kaadị dị ka nkeji 2 ma mụbaa ya site na kaadị 24 na-enye ihe dị ka nkeji 48, ya mere ihe dị ka nkeji 45 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-e3-b07-07.s.s2.model.1: Kaadị 4 n'ụbọchị maka ụbọchị 6 bụ kaadị 24, ma otu kaadị na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 2, ya mere ngụkọta bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 45.

l-e-e3-b01-21.title: Ọ gụrụ akwụkwọ: ebee ka ihe si gbagharịa?
l-e-e3-b01-21.goal: Soro ọrụ (ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ) maka ime "She reads a book" otu nzọụkwụ n'otu oge, chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ, ma dozie ya.
l-e-e3-b01-21.material: Ọ pụtara '(Ọ) na-agụ akwụkwọ'. Ọrụ: ① Ọ na-eme ugbu a ma ọ bụ otu onye ② Subject bụ She ③ Verb bụ read n'enweghị -s ④ Mechaa: She read a book
l-e-e3-b01-21.s.s1.o.a: ① Ọ na-eme ugbu a ma ọ bụ otu onye
l-e-e3-b01-21.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ otu onye ma ọ na-eme ugbu a, ya mere nke a bụ mmalite ziri ezi.
l-e-e3-b01-21.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ otu onye, ya mere She ziri ezi.
l-e-e3-b01-21.s.s1.o.d: ④ Mechaa: She read a book
l-e-e3-b01-21.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ọ bụ otu onye (She) ma ọ na-eme ugbu a, gbakwunye -s n'verb ka ọ bụrụ reads.
l-e-e3-b01-21.s.s2.model.0: She bụ otu onye ma ọ na-eme ugbu a, ya mere n'③ read ga-edozịrị ka ọ bụrụ reads.
